controller.description: The Zavbox TV menu is driven with a phone D-pad plus A, B and Home. After Play, the game must offer its own phone join, the way Party Mode does with its QR code.

games.title: Party Mode
games.description: Open-world off-road driving. Play solo on the 512 m map, or start a party on the 2 km world. Phones steer and a TV is the shared screen.
games.coverAlt: Cinematic key art of a stylised orange off-road car on a night road, with neon light and mountains ahead.
games.artAlt: An orange 4x4 parked on a gravel track in Party Mode, with hills and trees ahead.
games.notes: Opens on this TV. On that screen, choose Party Mode, then scan the QR code it shows with your phone to drive. Zavbox steps aside once the game starts.

games.title: Air Tennis
games.description: Stadium tennis you play with your body. Stand your phone up and its camera tracks you (one or two players), or swing the phone like a racket. 1P vs CPU, 2P Match, 2P Rally, Doubles, Training and more.
games.coverAlt: Key art of a sleek mannequin-style player smashing a glowing neon ball in a dark indoor arena with cyan court lines.
games.artAlt: Air Tennis in play: a player on a deep-blue court with glowing cyan lines, hitting a neon ball.
games.notes: Opens on this TV. Scan the QR code Air Tennis shows with your phone, pick Body camera (1 or 2 players) or Swing your phone, and follow the quick setup.
